title: Importance of Peritoneal Free Fluid Cultures in Acute Appendicitis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the frequency of positive free fluid cultures in both perforated and non-perforated appendicitis. In addition predictors of positive free fluid cultures will be analyzed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Appendicitis (Perforated/ Non-perforated) Free fluid Age: 6 - 90y

Exclusion Criteria:

* Immunosuppression (recent chemotherapy, chronic use of immunosuppressive medication) Age \< 6 and \> 90y
study_population: Patients with perforated or non-perforated appendicitis
